summary: The Android camera manager now clears its current Activity reference when that Activity is destroyed and refuses to attach an already-destroyed owner.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already shows the process-wide runtime owning the camera manager and the manager storing MainActivity as its lifecycle owner without clearing it on destruction. The September capture-isolation patch added an observer scoped to active captures, so it does not explain the idle retention. The offline history lookup stopped at a missing commit, leaving it unclear whether the camera feature shipped with the retention bug or an earlier change introduced it.
